_help: Act 2, the morning you leave Cairo, at the hotel: if no Egyptologist was hired (none of hired_eleanor, hired_pembroke, hired_hassan), Hassan comes to you and joins for free. act2.gd starts this; the expedition can't leave without an Egyptologist. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

start.speaker: hassan
start.line: Forgive me. I heard at Yacoub's that your expedition leaves today without anyone who can read a wall. I am Hassan al-Masri, and I would like to come.

choices.label: Accept gladly
choices.line: You're exactly what we're missing. Welcome aboard.

choices.label: Ask what he wants
choices.line: Nobody offers for nothing. What's your price?

terms.speaker: hassan
terms.line: No fee. Only a promise: when I say a door should stay closed, you will at least listen.

choices.label: No promises
choices.line: I'll decide about doors when I see them.

joined.speaker: hassan
joined.line: Then let us go and see what kind of man leads this expedition.

joined_cool.speaker: hassan
joined_cool.line: Very well. I shall have to find other ways of being heard.
